goal: Useful original content with sustainable economic profit, local production and no meetings

instances.name: Market Intelligence
instances.mandate: Identify audience problems and evidence, not select the editorial slate
instances.inputs: Dated public observations, audience feedback and research questions
instances.outputs: Opportunity dossiers, counterevidence and confidence limits

configuration.proposed: Queries, audience/language, inclusion and deduplication policies

components.status: unresolved: requires pinned native catalog and real adapters

composites.proposed_capabilities: Evidence collection / provenance normalization / problem comparison

processes.proposed: Accountable research cycle; source freshness and uncertainty review

instances.name: Content Strategy
instances.mandate: Choose differentiated viewer outcomes and allocate content priorities
instances.inputs: Opportunity dossiers, performance reports, capacity and revenue constraints
instances.outputs: Versioned content briefs, acceptance rubrics and portfolio decisions

configuration.proposed: Audience promise, editorial standards, experiment allocation and topic exclusions

components.status: unresolved: requires pinned native catalog and real adapters

flows.proposed: Compare alternatives → select brief → reserve capacity → revise or cancel

processes.proposed: Editorial planning and hypothesis review, with explicit owner approval gates

instances.name: Production
instances.mandate: Produce reproducible original media against an accepted brief
instances.inputs: Approved content brief, rights constraints and resource bindings
instances.outputs: Private release package, provenance, QA and actual effort record

configuration.proposed: Pinned model/voice/tool revisions, scene schema and render profile

components.status: unresolved: requires pinned native catalog and real adapters

flows.proposed: Script → original demo/diagrams → audio → render → QA → package

processes.proposed: Local production, maintenance and quality ownership; failed attempts retained

instances.name: Distribution
instances.mandate: Manage channels, release state and audience measurement delivery
instances.inputs: Accepted package, publication authorization, channel policy and account binding
instances.outputs: Release receipts or blocked status, analytics snapshots and corrections

configuration.proposed: Channel/account references, metadata, timezone, disclosure and release policy

components.status: unresolved: requires pinned native catalog and real adapters

composites.proposed_capabilities: Package-to-channel metadata / release-state tracking / analytics collection

flows.proposed: Validate package → approval → private staging → authorized release → reconcile

processes.proposed: Channel operations and takedown/correction lifecycle; publishing currently disabled

instances.name: Monetization
instances.mandate: Define and maintain appropriate eligible revenue mechanisms
instances.inputs: Viewer value, audience signals, verified eligibility and product/offer evidence
instances.outputs: Versioned monetization plan, approved offers and attributed receipt claims

configuration.proposed: Allowed programs, offer terms, disclosures, product versions and support envelope

components.status: unresolved: requires pinned native catalog and real adapters

composites.proposed_capabilities: Eligibility assessment / relevant-offer selection / product delivery contract

flows.proposed: Evaluate route → accept or reject → configure offer → monitor/refund/update

processes.proposed: Revenue-route governance; no guaranteed earnings or hidden custom service

instances.name: Audience Care
instances.mandate: Own feedback, corrections and asynchronous service exceptions
instances.inputs: Comments, questions, privacy/rights reports and optional customer issues
instances.outputs: Categorized signals, correction requests, resolutions and unresolved cases

configuration.proposed: Channels, response standards, consent/retention and escalation policy

components.status: unresolved: requires pinned native catalog and real adapters

composites.proposed_capabilities: Feedback triage / correction dossier / written response proposal

flows.proposed: Receive → classify → resolve within authority or escalate → close with record

processes.proposed: Audience trust and optional product support; no calls or meetings required

instances.name: Finance and Performance
instances.mandate: Reconcile money, total effort and business performance
instances.inputs: Cost events, release/cohort measures, attributable revenue and payout evidence
instances.outputs: Cost ledger, receipt reconciliation, budget envelope and decision reports

configuration.proposed: Currency, cost allocation, owner hour value, budget/time cap and income target

components.status: unresolved: requires pinned native catalog and real adapters

composites.proposed_capabilities: Cost reconciliation / revenue attribution / cohort comparison / budget forecast

flows.proposed: Ingest → reconcile → distinguish estimates/cash → assess → advise Operations

processes.proposed: Financial control and performance learning; no tax advice or automatic spend
